name: Monotonic Reads (Session Guarantee)
description: Monotonic reads session guarantee of Terry et al. (PDIS 1994): successive reads within a session reflect a non-decreasing set of writes, i.e. a session never observes an earlier state after observing a later one. One of the four session guarantees. Brzezinski et al. (2003) proved PRAM = read-your-writes ∧ monotonic reads ∧ monotonic writes (Viotti & Vukolić 2016, Eq. 20), so monotonic reads alone is strictly weaker than PRAM.

catSupport.note: A per-execution condition on one session's successive reads (the observed write set may not shrink), statable as a cat irreflexivity axiom over po and the communication relations.
